title: On Considering the offer for three days
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：consider　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 consider 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the headmaster ① considered the offer for three days in public, and every student in the school said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the headmaster ② considers the offer for three days in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ consider the offer for three days at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ considered the offer for three days before — a line in the record for October 1985 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Considering the offer for three days in public, the headmaster said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ consider the whole plan too costly in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Consider the whole plan too costly at once and never mention it again.

By 1998 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new student from the next school ⑧ considers the whole plan too costly in public every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ considered the offer for three days again when nobody else would.

⑩ To consider the offer for three days, my mother said in 2003, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the school remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the school forgets, somebody considers the offer for three days in silence again and somebody must consider the offer for three days in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 考虑（一般过去式 considered the offer for three days：1991 年校长头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 考虑（一般现在 considers the offer for three days：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 考虑（不定式 to consider the offer for three days：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 考虑（过去完成时 had considered the offer for three days：1985 年十月的学籍册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 考虑（动名词 considering the offer for three days 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 认为（consider the whole plan too costly：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去认为认为整套方案太费钱）
G. v. 认为（consider the whole plan too costly：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 考虑（后段两处：新来的学生照例 considers the whole plan too costly，而母亲又一次 considered the offer for three days）

answers.why: consider 意为“考虑”，1991 年校长当着众人面考虑把这提议想了三天，那是学堂里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 considered。
consider 意为“考虑”，自那以后校长一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 considers。
consider 意为“考虑”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯考虑把这提议想了三天”，此处为不定式 to consider the offer for three days。
consider 意为“考虑”，学籍册里 十月 那行字说明早在 1998 年之前就有人考虑过，故用过去完成时 had considered。
consider 意为“考虑”，校长说“考虑把这提议想了三天这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 considering the offer for three days 作主语。
consider 意为“认为”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去认为认为整套方案太费钱”，should ever 之后用原形 consider the whole plan too costly。
consider 意为“认为”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻认为认为整套方案太费钱（consider the whole plan too costly at once），以后再也不要提起。
consider 意为“考虑”，新来的学生每个学年都照例认为认为整套方案太费钱，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 considers。
consider 意为“考虑”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面考虑把这提议想了三天，用一般过去式 considered 叙述。
consider 意为“考虑”，结尾那句是母亲 2003 年的话：要考虑把这提议想了三天，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和学堂记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 consider 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the headmaster considered the offer for three days in public, and nobody in the school forgot it.
Even now the headmaster considers the offer for three days in silence whenever the school asks.
Considering the offer for three days in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever consider the whole plan too costly in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new student from the next school considers the whole plan too costly in public every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother considered the offer for three days again, and the school remembered that half.
